title: Pressure and equilibrium
caption: N₂O₄ ⇌ 2NO₂. Squeezing the mixture into a smaller volume raises the pressure; the equilibrium shifts towards the side with fewer gas molecules, N₂O₄, partly relieving the change. The atoms are the same; only their grouping changes.
alt: Left: a box with N₂O₄ and NO₂ molecules. Right: the compressed mixture, now with more N₂O₄ and fewer NO₂.
description: After compression: 4 N₂O₄ and 2 NO₂, fewer molecules overall (6 against 8).
